name: Extra Implantation Points
body:
You can go beyond your implantation limits.

Benefit(s): You gain two additional implantation points.

You can allocate these points between your Intelligence and Constitution scores as you choose.

Special: You can select Extra Implantation Points multiple times. Its effects stack.
